The Wind Wrote Back

STS-HS12-L2-1400P-HSSCIENG1112-PPX-NAV-03 • HS Science: Engineering Design 11–12 • Predicting the Effects of a Design on a System
Look at the picture. You will answer some questions about it. Press the play button to hear each question. Record your answer for each question. You can listen to your answer and record it again. Click SUBMIT RECORDINGS when you have answered all the questions.
JUST FOR FUN · OPTIONAL
Kaya's class lives near the ocean, where wooden sand fences hold the dunes in place. Their pen pals in Minot, North Dakota mailed them a plan for a living snow fence: four rows of shrubs planted twelve feet apart to keep drifts off a gravel road. Both fences do the same job in two very different places. They slow the wind down until it drops what it is carrying.
If the class planted the shrub rows twice as far from the road, what do you think would happen to the road?
